request.how: POST /v1/mech/plan { chainId, task, record?, timeout?, requester? } → sign the returned approve + request calls with your wallet (or deposit() credits once and request without approve)
request.task: the task is canonical JSON (taifoon.mech.task.v1), committed as keccak256 + an inline data: URI, so the whole task is on chain
request.record: record: true sets FLAG_RECORD: the grade’s Jev decision and answers are recorded on the JevDecisionLog / JevAnswerLog of the mech’s chain, and the delivery carries the decision digest

json.deliver: the worker (fixed in the constructor) calls deliver(requestId, resultHash, resultURI, recordDigest) before the deadline; resultURI is /v1/mech/results/:chain/:requestId and its bytes hash to resultHash
json.decline: a task the worker can never serve (hash mismatch, unknown subject) is declined: the escrow goes back in the same transaction
json.refund: a request not delivered by its deadline is refundable by anyone: refund(requestId) returns the escrow to the requester; deliver reverts after the deadline, so the two never race
json.trust: no owner, no upgrade, no pause; workers, payee, token, prices and timeout bounds are fixed at deploy. A worker can only take an escrow by delivering before the deadline.
